applies_to: AAON rooftop units, air handlers and DOAS units controlled by the VCCX2 (ASM01698) unit controller.
summary: The VCCX2 is AAON's main unit controller and has an on-board BACnet MS/TP port. Its object map has about 280 read-only analog inputs (temperatures, pressures, airflow, compressor and refrigerant module data), about 100 writable analog values (setpoints, offsets, overrides and BAS-supplied sensor values) and about 150 read-only binary inputs (alarms, relay and module status).
notes: AI objects are read-only and AV objects are read/write; of the sensor values, only AV 72, 73 and 76-79 may be written by the BAS.
Points for refrigerant modules (RSMV/RSMD/RSMZ), preheater, MODGAS, MHGRV and expansion boards only report data when that hardware is installed.
AI 159-248 RSMZ warning, fault, lockout and VFD status points are bit strings; the bit meanings are in the guide's Bitfields tables.
Units are not printed for analog inputs; analog value units shown here come from the guide's min/max limits.
MAC address, device ID and baud rate are set from the controller's LCD BACnet screens.

integration.summary: Connect the on-board MS/TP port and set MAC address, device ID and baud on the controller's LCD BACnet screens. The BAS schedules the unit with AV 67 Schedule Force, adjusts setpoints with the occupied heating/cooling and supply-air AVs, and can supply sensor values through AV 72-79 when the controller is configured for it. Alarms are read from the BI objects.

integration.enable: Occupancy comes from AV 67 Schedule Force (0 = follow the controller schedule, 1 = forced occupied, 2 = forced unoccupied), the internal week schedule, a GPC-XP broadcast schedule, or the BI4 remote forced occupied contact. AV 68, AV 69, AV 70 and AV 71 override HVAC mode, fan VFD, OA damper and supply setpoint; writing Auto (0 or 65535 as listed) hands control back.
integration.remote_sensors: If the controller is configured for it, the BAS can write AV 72 Space Temperature, AV 73 Space Humidity, AV 76 Relief Pressure, AV 77 CO2, AV 78 Outdoor Air Temperature and AV 79 Outdoor Air Humidity; these are the only sensor values the BAS may write. The guide gives no refresh timeout for them. A relief pressure value received over BACnet that is out of range raises an alarm.
setup: MAC address 0-127, default 1; set on the LCD BACnet screen.
Device ID up to seven digits, set on the same screen; no default is printed.
gotchas: Writing AV 70 OA damper override to anything between 0 and 100 % while compressors run locks the compressors out; use AV 49 minimum position instead.
An emergency shutdown (smoke detector/firestat input) cancels all BACnet override commands.
Refrigerant module, preheater, MODGAS, MHGRV and expansion-board points only report when that hardware is installed.
AI 159-248 RSMZ status points are bit strings; decode them with the guide's bitfield tables.

source.title: VCCX2 Controller Technical Guide (Appendix C: BACnet Guide)
